IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Brandland, T. Sheldon, Stevens and Murray

Bill.BriefDescription: Changing provisions regarding products liability actions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to products liability; and adding a new section tochapter 7.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In a products liability action alleging that an injury was causedby a failure to provide adequate warnings or information with regard toa pharmaceutical product, the defendant or defendants shall not beliable with respect to such allegations if the warnings or informationthat accompanied the product in its distribution were those required bythe United States food and drug administration for a product approvedpursuant to the federal food, drug, and cosmetic act (21 U.S.C. Sec.321, et seq.) or section 351 of the public health service act (42U.S.C. Sec. 262), or the warnings provided were those set forth inmonographs developed by the United States food and drug administrationfor pharmaceutical products that may be distributed without an approvednew drug application.
